description: This file defines private interface functions and includes for managing security domain group members in a wireless LAN context, with function prototypes for adding, setting event handlers, deleting, starting, stopping, and restarting members.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_addMember
methods.description: Adds a member to a security domain group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_setMemberEvtHdlrs
methods.description: Sets event handlers for a member of a security domain group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_delMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a security domain group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_startMember
methods.description: Starts a specified member within a security domain group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_stopMember
methods.description: Stops a specified member within a security domain group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_isMemberStarted
methods.description: Checks if a member is currently started.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_isMemberRestarting
methods.description: Checks if a member is in the process of restarting.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_restartMember
methods.description: Restarts a specified member within a security domain group.

methods.name: wld_secDmnGrp_hasMemberRestarting
methods.description: Checks if any members are currently restarting.
